name: What is the typical timeline for a custom tile shower installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a custom tile shower installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom tile shower installation typically takes 1-3 weeks, depending on the scope and complexity of the project. This includes demolition, substrate preparation, waterproofing, tile setting, grouting, and final fixture installation. The timeline can be extended if custom elements like niches, benches, or specific waterproofing systems are incorporated, or if there are delays in material delivery. Hometelligent Inc. provides a detailed project schedule after the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom tile shower installations typically take 1-3 weeks, varying with project complexity and material availability.
